note: Drift ledger between the .od mockup (contract) and the Nuxt port. One row per section. The developer follows the mockup; this file is the honest record of how far each port page has caught up. Bump design_version in DESIGN.md on any contract change, then re-audit rows whose mockup_touched is newer than synced_to.

fidelity_levels.full: Port reproduces the mockup section's layout, states, interactions, and honesty signals.
fidelity_levels.interactive: Core list/detail + primary actions work; secondary modals/edge-states pending.
fidelity_levels.structural: Layout + classification + mock data present; rich interactions are stubs.
fidelity_levels.stub: Honest placeholder (SectionStub) — backend not built/enabled; no operable controls.

sync_status.synced: Port matches mockup at synced_to version.
sync_status.drifted: Mockup changed after synced_to; port needs a catch-up pass.
sync_status.ahead: Port intentionally exceeds the mockup (rare; note why).

i18n_levels.keyed: Every visible string resolves through t(); ru.json, en.json, and zh.json carry the keys.
i18n_levels.partial: Some strings keyed, some still inline in the template.
i18n_levels.hardcoded: Strings are literal in the template (pre-i18n default). Not translation-ready.
